title: Import files
intro: Bring over an existing file collection in a few steps: choose a ZIP archive (including Google Takeout) or a whole folder, define rules for tags, capture date and albums, check the preview and start.
othersImport: This import was prepared by {name}. You can view and cancel it, but not edit it.

source.title: Where do the files come from?
source.zipHint: One or more ZIP files, e.g. a download from OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Takeout (upload split archives one by one).
source.folderHint: Choose a folder on this device, e.g. a synced OneDrive or Google Drive folder. Only files you import are transferred.
source.cloudHint: Direct connections to OneDrive and Google Drive will follow later. Until then: download the folder or create a Takeout export and upload it here.
source.limits: Per import at most 50,000 files and 100 GB; documents up to 20 MB, images up to 100 MB, ZIP archives up to 10 GB each. Only one import runs per club at a time.
source.uploadZipHint: Only the table of contents is read. For Google Takeout, upload all parts one after another; the «Takeout» folder is detected automatically.
source.uploadFolderHint: At first only the list of files is sent. Your browser uploads the files themselves after the start - keep this window open then.
source.dropZip: Drag ZIP files here or choose them.
source.dropFolder: Drag a folder here or choose it.
source.archiveAdded: {count, plural, one {Archive added.} other {# archives added.}}
source.listed: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} found ({size}, {archives, plural, =0 {folder} one {# archive} other {# archives}}).

options.albumsEnabled: Put images into albums by rule
options.albumsHint: Off by default: images go to the gallery and can be added to an album later via multi-select.

cancel.label: Discard import
cancel.draftConfirm: Discard this import? Uploaded archives and the file list will be deleted.
cancel.runningConfirm: Cancel the import? Files already imported are kept, open ones are no longer taken over.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.import_active: An import is already running or waiting in this club. Finish or cancel it first.
errors.zip_invalid: This is not a valid ZIP file.
errors.too_many_files: Too many files: at most {max} per import.
errors.too_many_bytes: Too large: at most {max_gb} GB per import.
errors.too_many_archives: Too many archives in one import.
errors.manifest_too_large: The file list is too large for one transfer.
errors.not_owner: Only the person who prepared the import can edit it.
errors.invalid_status: The import has changed in the meantime. Please reload the page.
errors.invalid_rules: At least one rule is invalid.
errors.nothing_to_import: With these rules no file will be imported.
errors.quota_exceeded: The club's storage quota is not sufficient. Reduce the selection or free up space and then resume the import.
errors.source_gone: The source is no longer available. Please start a new import.
errors.staging_busy: The server is still processing. The upload will continue shortly.
errors.wrong_source: This source does not match this import.
errors.invalid_paths: The upload's file list is invalid.
errors.expired: The import was discarded after 7 days without being started.
errors.requester_unauthorized: The import was stopped because the person who started it no longer has permission to do so.
errors.disk_full: The server is currently short of disk space. Please try again later.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Rules are checked in order. Tags are combined, for the capture date the first matching rule applies, «Do not import» always wins.
rules.empty: Without rules all matching files are taken over unchanged.
rules.matches: {count, plural, =0 {matches no file} one {matches # file} other {matches # files}}
rules.pathGlobHelp: For example *.pdf, Photos/20??/* or **/Camp/**. * stands for any characters within one folder, ** for any number of folders.
rules.nameRegexHelp: For example ^IMG_\d+ or (?i)minutes. Back references and lookarounds are not supported.
rules.dateHelp: Only applies to images without a capture date in the file and appears as «estimated».
rules.skipHelp: Matching files are neither transferred nor imported.

errors.regex_unsupported: This expression is not supported (no back references or lookarounds).
errors.out_of_range: The date must be between 1826 and today.

rules.albumsOff: Album rules only apply when «Put images into albums by rule» is switched on.

preview.title: Preview
preview.kinds: {images, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}, {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
preview.quotaExceeded: The import needs up to {planned}, only {free} is free. Reduce the selection with rules or free up space.
preview.ruleErrors: At least one rule is invalid - it is not applied in the preview and the import cannot start yet.
preview.conflictHint: Conflict: several rules set a different capture date. The first rule in the list applies.
preview.existingAlbums: These albums already exist and will be extended: {names}

start.label: Start import
start.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} ({size})? The rules cannot be changed afterwards.

progress.title: Import running
progress.hint: You can leave this page. For a folder upload this window must stay open until all files are transferred.
progress.reselect: {count} files have not been transferred yet. Choose the same folder again to continue the upload.
progress.waitingForOwner: The import is waiting for files from the browser of the person who started it.

report.title: Report
report.cancelledCount: {count, plural, one {# no longer taken over} other {# no longer taken over}}
report.retention: The report is kept as long as at least one imported file exists.
report.albumReusedOldest: Album «{name}»: {count} albums with this name exist, the oldest was extended.
